checks.name: both fully oriented one-dimensional generators
checks.scope: Exact vectors, full symplectic derivative and determinant square; not arbitrary-loop classification.

checks.name: actual ordered Gaussian coordinate and reciprocal switches
checks.scope: Both switch directions, including zero-signature remaining blocks in five dimensions.

checks.name: full nonconstant Schur and section-derivative calculation
checks.scope: Nonzero marked off-diagonal block, varying indefinite normal block, all inverse derivatives and extension-vector cancellations; also both public 2x2 examples.

checks.name: regular indefinite crossing and exact simple split
checks.scope: Exact local matrices and both determinant derivatives; supported arbitrary-path homotopy remains a written argument.

checks.name: five actual unitary/real plane frames and SU2 column formula
checks.scope: Unitary matrices, isotropic real spans, identical projection matrices after reflection, determinant sign/square and explicit SU2 formula; no simple-connectedness inference from samples.

checks.name: exact noncommuting determinant ratio and phase derivative
checks.scope: Entire rational two-variable matrix path, not just diagonal or marked-point substitution.

checks.name: positive-square-root Sylvester derivatives in six dimensions
checks.scope: Explicit inverse on all entries of six positive diagonal models. General smooth square-root dependence is the implicit-theorem proof in the lesson.

checks.name: five exact crossing inventories and independent branch/winding samples
checks.scope: Exact rational simple-crossing times; independent 4001-point determinant unwrapping and both transverse branch formulas. These finite samples do not prove the winding/crossing theorem.

checks.name: complete ordinary tangent Gauss-map example
checks.scope: Exact embedded-circle derivative, full tangent vector and determinant derivative; the circle is ordinary and not conic.

checks.name: eight bounded stratum dimension inventories and solution completeness
checks.scope: Arithmetic of the imported stratum codimension and exercise-marker/control-byte checks; the actual strata and critical-value proofs are written mathematics.

checks.name: nonunitary common-complement shear with a horizontal spectator
checks.scope: Exact shear symplecticity and complete crossing-form identity; five finite winding controls. The fixed-frame determinant changes pointwise, so it cannot be treated as symplectically invariant. Its winding is invariant by the written homotopy proof.

generality_guard: Exact bounded examples and finite numerical samples do not establish arbitrary-loop topology, smoothing, lifting or generic perturbation. Those require the written proofs and independent review.
